worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.summary: Gathers a puff of pollen that both stings and soothes, then lobs it at the chosen spot on a low arc: on contact or landing it bursts — foes inside are stung by sharp pollen, allies inside (the user included) who are missing health drink it and recover. One puff, two results.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.use.0: One puff that harms at range and rescues nearby allies
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.use.1: Dust a small cluster of foes together
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.use.2: Top up an injured self or ally between exchanges
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.description: When it bursts, every enemy inside takes one hit of about %1$s Bug special damage; allies inside who are missing health (the user included) each recover %2$s%% of their maximum health, up to their missing amount. One puff, two outcomes decided by whoever it lands among. The target's special defence, type match-up and criticals settle on the hit.
It bursts to a %1$s block radius and can be thrown as far as %2$s blocks; one burst stings at most %3$s enemies, while allies inside are healed as usual.
The puff flies on a low arc at %1$s blocks per tick and bursts on hitting a foe or the ground; it leaves after %2$s s of wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.nurture.on: Nurture on: about ×1.3 heal and ×1.05 radius, at the cost of about ×0.8 blast and cooldown +6 ticks, to rescue allies and yourself.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.nurture.off: Nurture off (sting): about ×1.25 blast, at the cost of about ×0.75 heal, to burst foes.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.timing: Throw range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.pollenpuff.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s, the heal to %3$s%%, and the throw range to %4$s.
On: about ×1.3 heal and ×1.05 radius, at the cost of about ×0.8 blast and cooldown +6 ticks, to rescue allies and yourself. Off (sting): about ×1.25 blast, at the cost of about ×0.75 heal.
On: the companion throws pollen puffs at injured allies (below the threshold), spending its turn to heal. Off: it only uses them on itself and on foes, focusing on damage.
The companion only considers Pollen Puff when the target is this close; lower it to throw only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
An ally is healed only below this fraction of health; lower it to keep attacking, raise it to rescue as soon as anyone is hurt.
